islands.name: Wander Trail
islands.theme: Unplanned walks, cairns, meadow edges, and having nowhere to be.

levels.name: The First Cairn
levels.description: One stone back on a path nobody marked.

levels.name: The Bend
levels.description: The trail bends away from the village routes again.

levels.name: The Meadow Edge
levels.description: Grass meets path, and the flowers are back along it.

levels.name: Nowhere to Be
levels.description: The trail opens onto ground that goes nowhere in particular.

chapters.title: The First Cairn
chapters.prompt:
This was my trail. It never had a marker, and the Mistwisps liked that: nobody looked for it. Four of them sit over the first cairn now.

We put one stone back today. How do we start?

fallbackOrder.title: The First Cairn
fallbackOrder.description: Bring what the first cairn is missing.

choices.label: Just walk
choices.reply: Just walk. The stone is wherever we stop.

order.title: Wherever We Stop
order.description: Bring what the first cairn is missing.

choices.openingConclusion: Make light on the board. What you make flies straight up; bigger things hit harder.
choices.returnLine: Set them down. The first stone in years, right where we stopped.
choices.resolutionLine: It held. The first cairn is ours again.

choices.label: Look first
choices.reply: Look first. The trail shows itself if you let it.

order.title: The Stone That Was There
order.description: Bring what the first cairn is missing.

choices.openingConclusion: Make light on the board. Look where it lands before you make the next.
choices.returnLine: Set them down. You saw where it wanted to be.
choices.resolutionLine: It held. The first cairn is ours again, and it was there all along.

choices.label: Side by side
choices.reply: Side by side, then. Two pairs of feet make a path faster.

order.title: Two Sets of Prints
order.description: Bring what the first cairn is missing.

choices.openingConclusion: Make light on the board, the two of us. Every merge pushes them back a little.
choices.returnLine: Set them down together. The first stone is ours.
choices.resolutionLine: We built it together, and it held. The first cairn is ours again.

chapters.title: Off the Marked Path

callbackLine.unplanned: We stopped, and the stone held. So they moved to the bend.
callbackLine.looking: You looked, and the stone held. So they moved to the bend.
callbackLine.together: Our stone held. So they moved to the bend.

chapters.prompt:
Past the cairn the trail bends away from the village routes. That bend is where they feed; nothing has walked it in years.

We take the bend back today. Which way round?

fallbackOrder.title: The Bend
fallbackOrder.description: Bring a Hiking Gear and a Shoe for the bend in the trail.

choices.label: The long way
choices.reply: The long way. More trail is more trail.

order.title: The Long Way Round
order.description: Bring a Hiking Gear and a Shoe for the longer bend.

choices.openingConclusion: Make light on the board. They give ground where the light lands.
choices.returnLine: Set them down at the bend. Watch them give ground.
choices.resolutionLine: The bend is walked again. More of the trail is ours.

choices.label: The quiet way
choices.reply: The quiet way. You hear more.

order.title: The Quiet Bend
order.description: Bring a Hiking Gear and a Shoe for the bend nobody hears.

choices.openingConclusion: Make light on the board. They give ground where the light lands.
choices.returnLine: Set them down quietly. Watch them give ground.
choices.resolutionLine: The bend is walked again, and it is quiet. More of the trail is ours.

choices.label: Your way
choices.reply: Your way. A guest picks the bend.

order.title: The Bend You Chose
order.description: Bring a Hiking Gear and a Shoe for the bend you pointed at.

choices.openingConclusion: Make light on the board. Your bend first.
choices.returnLine: Set them down where you pointed. Watch them give ground.
choices.resolutionLine: Your bend is walked again. More of the trail is ours.

chapters.title: The Meadow Edge

callbackLine.unplanned: The long bend held. So they went to the meadow edge.
callbackLine.looking: The quiet bend held. So they went to the meadow edge.
callbackLine.together: Your bend held. So they went to the meadow edge.

chapters.prompt:
The trail runs out into meadow. They sit along the edge where grass meets path, and the flowers went with them.

We bring the edge back today. What grows there?

fallbackOrder.title: The Meadow Edge
fallbackOrder.description: Make a Rare Flower and a Shoe for the meadow edge.

choices.label: Whatever comes up
choices.reply: Whatever comes up. The meadow decides.

order.title: Whatever Comes Up
order.description: Make a Rare Flower and a Shoe for an edge that grows how it likes.

choices.openingConclusion: Make light on the board. They give it up one stretch at a time.
choices.returnLine: Set them down along the edge.
choices.resolutionLine: The edge grew back how it liked. More of the trail is ours.

choices.label: The ones you notice
choices.reply: The ones you notice. Those are the ones that matter.

order.title: The Ones You Noticed
order.description: Make a Rare Flower and a Shoe for the flowers you stopped for.

choices.openingConclusion: Make light on the board. Look where the light lands.
choices.returnLine: Set them down where you stopped.
choices.resolutionLine: The flowers you noticed came back first. More of the trail is ours.

choices.label: Ones we both like
choices.reply: Ones we both like. There is room for two kinds.

order.title: Room for Two Kinds
order.description: Make a Rare Flower and a Shoe for an edge with room for both of us.

choices.openingConclusion: Make light on the board, the two of us.
choices.resolutionLine: Two kinds grew. More of the trail is ours.

chapters.title: Nowhere to Be

callbackLine.unplanned: The edge came back. So they went to the end of the trail, where there is no end.
callbackLine.looking: The edge came back. So they went to the end of the trail, where there is no end.
callbackLine.together: The edge came back. So they went to the end of the trail, where there is no end.

chapters.prompt:
The last of them sit where the trail stops being a trail and is just open ground. That is the whole point of it, and they know.

We open the last of it today. What is a trail for?

fallbackOrder.title: Nowhere to Be
fallbackOrder.description: Make a Boot and an Expedition Kit for the open ground.

choices.label: For going
choices.reply: For going. It does not need an end.

order.title: For Going
order.description: Make a Boot and an Expedition Kit for a trail that only goes.

choices.openingConclusion: Make light on the last patch. When they go this time, they go for good.
choices.returnLine: Set it down at the end that is not one.
choices.resolutionLine: They are gone. The whole trail is ours, and it goes nowhere in particular.

choices.label: For seeing
choices.reply: For seeing. Every bend is a new one.

order.title: For Seeing
order.description: Make a Boot and an Expedition Kit for a trail worth looking at.

choices.openingConclusion: Make light on the last patch. Look at it while you do.
choices.returnLine: Set it down. Look at what we walked.
choices.resolutionLine: They are gone. The whole trail is ours, and you saw all of it.

choices.label: For company
choices.reply: For company. A trail is better with someone on it.

order.title: For Company
order.description: Make a Boot and an Expedition Kit for a trail walked together.

choices.openingConclusion: Make light on the last patch, the two of us.
choices.returnLine: Set it down together. That is the last of them.
choices.resolutionLine: They are gone. The whole trail is ours, and we walked it together.

payoff.closingLine: Whatever comes next, it starts from here. Come by when you have nowhere to be.

unplanned.title: The Going Way
unplanned.reflection: No plan, every time, and the trail came back anyway.
unplanned.summary: Just going brought the trail back.

looking.title: The Noticing Way
looking.reflection: You looked before every step. The trail showed itself.

together.title: The Together Way
together.reflection: Two of us on it every time. The trail noticed.
together.summary: Walking it together brought the trail back.

unplanned.label: We just went
unplanned.reply: We did. It never needed a plan.

copy.discoveryDialogue: You looked this way, and the Mist let go of me. This was my trail; it never had a marker, and the Mistwisps have been sitting on it for years. Help me walk it back?
copy.revealReactionLine: The Mist lifts from a path nobody marked. The cairns are still standing. Someone kept walking it.
copy.mistDescription: Something in there keeps walking a trail that leads nowhere in particular, and something else is making sure nobody follows.
copy.returnNoteTitle: Meet me on the Wander Trail
copy.returnNoteHint: Return to Wanderling's trail for the next scene

stateLabels.available: Choose how this stretch of trail comes back.

I know where the first stone goes. Whenever you are ready.

speech.delivery_requested: This stretch is spent. What we need next is on your board.

restoration_ready.text: We are close now. A little more light and this stretch can be walked.

variants.text: Everything is ready. This one is on me.
We have what we need. Whenever you are ready.
{{coins|raw}} of {{cost|raw}} Glow so far. The trail can wait.

copy.fallbackReturn: Everything for {{chapterTitle}} is here. Set it down and the Mist has to let go.

fallbackResolution.text: The trail remembered a little more, because we walked it.

variants.text: Every stretch is walked. The Mist has nothing left here to keep.

copy.wakeHandoffLine: I was walking a trail nobody could see. Then you looked. There are other places under the Mist, and someone resting in each of them.
copy.sleepingHint: The Mist is keeping someone on this trail. They will wake once Steppling is out of his Egg.

fell: One gone. It was sitting on my cairn.
wispLines.last: The last one goes. Look at the trail.
